Multi-contrast pseudobulk differential expression

run_dge_multicontrast.Rd

Runs a collection of two-group pseudobulk edgeR comparisons on one object, aggregating the raw counts once (through SCUBA::pseudobulk()) and testing every contrast on the resulting sample x group profiles. Contrasts that are not replicated enough for edgeR (see check_pseudobulk_design()) fall back to the cell-level Wilcoxon test of run_dge(); the method column of the result says which test produced each row. This is the natural way to compare cell-level groups such as clusters across biological samples: those contrasts are paired designs (~ sample + group), which edgeR handles.

Usage

run_dge_multicontrast(
  object,
  group_by,
  sample_by,
  contrast_mode = c("pairwise", "one_vs_rest", "reference"),
  groups = NULL,
  reference_group = NULL,
  layer = NULL,
  seurat_assay = NULL,
  min_cells = 10L,
  positive_only = FALSE,
  remove_raw_pval = FALSE,
  robust = FALSE,
  p_adjust_scope = c("contrast", "global", "both"),
  test_use = "edgeR"
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, AnnData or file-backed SCUBA object (scuba_source), or a pre-aggregated scuba_pseudobulk from SCUBA::pseudobulk() (then group_by and sample_by are taken from the object and no fallback is possible).

group_by

Metadata column containing the groups to compare.

sample_by

Metadata column containing biological sample identifiers.

contrast_mode

Comparison strategy: "pairwise" compares every pair of selected groups; "one_vs_rest" compares each selected group with all other observed groups pooled within each sample; "reference" compares every selected non-reference group with reference_group.

groups

Optional character vector of groups to use. The default uses every non-missing value observed in group_by, in observed order. In one_vs_rest mode, this selects numerator groups; the rest side still pools all other observed groups.

reference_group

Reference denominator required when contrast_mode = "reference".

layer

Raw-count layer. Defaults to "counts". For AnnData objects whose counts live in X or raw, pass "X" or "raw" explicitly.

seurat_assay

Assay / modality holding the raw counts (default: the object's default assay, as SCUBA defines it).

min_cells

Minimum cells required per sample/comparison-side pseudobulk profile.

positive_only

Whether to retain only positive log2 fold changes.

remove_raw_pval

Whether to remove the raw p-value column.

robust

Whether to use robust empirical Bayes estimation in edgeR::glmQLFit().

p_adjust_scope

Multiple-testing scope. "contrast" retains the within-contrast adjustment; "global" replaces pval_adj with BH adjustment over every returned gene/contrast test; "both" retains within-contrast pval_adj and adds pval_adj_global. Global adjustment is applied before positive_only filtering.

test_use

Only "edgeR" is supported here; cell-level tests are the per-contrast fallback, not a choice.

Value

A tibble with the columns group_1, group_2, contrast, method, group, feature, avgExpr, log2FC, pval, pval_adj (and, for rows from the Wilcoxon fallback, auc, pct_in, pct_out; NA on edgeR rows). The edger_multicontrast_details attribute holds the contrast table (with method, design_type and reason) and the per-contrast details.
